capabilities: Insert Tanakh verses with nikud and cantillation as Markdown quotes
Search verses by transliteration typed on a regular keyboard
Search by reference in multiple languages and verse ranges
Generate AlHaTorah deep links to Mikraot Gedolot
disambiguation: Not a Bible study or reader tool; it only inserts verses into notes rather than browsing or annotating scripture.
extras: Hebrew text is bundled offline; only translations and AlHaTorah links need internet. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Inserting Hebrew Bible verses in Obsidian normally requires switching to a Hebrew keyboard layout and sourcing accurate vocalized text yourself.

relations.evidence: Translations: fetched on demand from the Sefaria library (requires internet, optional).
one checkbox adds a link that opens the verse in Mikraot Gedolot (Rashi, Ramban, Ibn Ezra side-by-side).

summary: Offline Tanakh verse inserter that finds Hebrew verses via transliteration typing, references, or Hebrew text, and inserts them with nikud and cantillation.
